symptom: MDL-WIDGET56 reported every other mode's required properties on a combo box set with `attribute:` (12, attributeEnumeration among them) and refEntity/refSearchAttr/linkedDs on a data grid drop-down filter; mx check 11.16.1 builds both with 0 errors.
cause: Three gaps. The hide rules were judged on the statement's values only, so source/optionsSourceType, which exec writes from the template (context, enumeration), were unknown and no mode rule fired. A property set through its MDL keyword (`attribute:` -> attributeEnumeration) was not counted as set. And the drop-down filter hides its association properties in a function invoked as a ternary's then-branch, `"attr"===e.baseType?t=function(e,t){hide([...refEntity...]),...}(e,t):...`, which parseGuard read as unguarded (its text ends at `{`) and whose nested hides lost the outer condition.
fix: validateWidgetRequired fills unset keys from templateWrittenDefaults before judging hide rules, treats any key with a value as set, and skips an isLinked datasource (the grid fills it; mpk.PropertyDef.IsLinked). ternaryThenIIFECondition gives a hide in such a function the ternary's condition (first statement) or adds it as an And term, only when the function is invoked with its own parameter names.
insight: Pick the fixture by what the package ships: PedApp's Combobox 2.5.0 and drop-down filter mpk carry no editorConfig.js, so no hide rule exists there and a correct fix still fails the test. `unzip -l` on the fixture's mpk before debugging the extractor would have saved the detour. Control: the association-mode combo box still reports optionsSourceAssociationCaptionAttribute, which mx check reports as CE0642.
